verdict.rationale: Anthropic provides a dedicated skill-creator meta-skill that creates new skills and iteratively improves them, benchmarks performance, and optimizes descriptions for triggering; a public open spec (agentskills.io) defines required SKILL.md structure, frontmatter, and folder layout; and a template repo (template/SKILL.md) gives a scaffold to follow. Community evidence corroborates hands-on authoring of custom skills, though some users report unreliable auto-invocation which is a separate discovery-trigger concern, not an authoring/packaging gap. missing for 10: no independent hands-on report specifically validating the skill-creator meta-skill workflow end-to-end, and no evidence of automated packaging/validation tooling (e.g., a linter/CLI to package a skill for distribution) beyond manual folder conventions.
